'''Alpha Squadron''' was an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] squadron of [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defenders]] serving the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], they engaged rogue [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Demetrius Zaarin]]'s [[Zaarin coup forces|for]][[Zaarin's fleet|ces]] in [[Zaarin insurrection|his insurrection]].
